item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Puff pastry pizza tart with tomato, mushrooms, cheese and olives. Served with Italian tomato salad and cornichons on the side. (1+6+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Melanzane alla parmigiana, panko-breaded aubergine with spaghetti in marinara sauce, topped with gremolata and parmesan. Served with grilled courgette salad with spinach and balsamic glaze on the side. (1+2+6+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: moussaka with potatoes, aubergines and gratinated béchamel. (1+2+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Vegetable lasagne, made the classic way, with lentils and beans as protein. (1+6+10+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Sicilian-inspired arancini, golden fried rice balls filled with vegetables and melting mozzarella, served on a deep, umami-rich tomato sauce and topped with gremolata and parmesan. Served with fennel and orange salad, chilli sauce and marinated mushrooms on the side. (1+2+6+13+15)
